title: 抽出共享额度策略 crate（门禁 + 回填），Windows 改为调用

target.module: core/collector（新增共享策略 crate）；apps/win src-tauri

goal: 把额度门禁（plan）与额度回填（carry_over_skipped、annotate_attempts、annotate_provider 及其判定助手）从 apps/win/src-tauri/src/quota_policy.rs 提为 core/collector 下无网络、无文件 I/O 的纯 Rust crate，接口以 serde_json::Value 进出；Windows src-tauri 改为调用该 crate 并删除本地实现。迁移前先为额度回填补双端对拍 fixture（mac QuotaCarryOverMerger 与 Windows carry_over_skipped 对同一组输入），确认两端口径一致后再迁移。范围只含门禁与回填（design/08 第 4.2 节）。

precheck.description: 确认共享策略 crate 尚不存在，门禁与回填仍在两端各自实现
precheck.command: ls core/collector/crates; grep -n '^pub fn plan\|^pub fn carry_over_skipped\|^pub fn annotate_attempts' apps/win/src-tauri/src/quota_policy.rs; grep -n 'package enum QuotaCarryOverMerger\|package static func plan' apps/macos/Sources/BruceAppCore/QuotaRefreshPolicy.swift
precheck.expected: crates 下无共享策略 crate；Windows quota_policy.rs 与 mac QuotaRefreshPolicy.swift 各有门禁与回填实现
precheck.evidence: 2026-10-27 开工前实测: core/collector/crates 下仅 aggregate / application / bridge / credential / domain / local / provider / runtime 八个 crate, 无共享策略 crate; apps/win/src-tauri/src/quota_policy.rs 第 198 / 312 / 339 行各有 plan / annotate_attempts / carry_over_skipped, mac QuotaRefreshPolicy.swift 第 60 / 341 行各有 plan 与 QuotaCarryOverMerger, 门禁与回填仍在两端各自实现, 未完成

after: scripts/adflow-verify  # 收口前门禁：Exit 4 禁止置 completed；目标状态预检使用 --card T13 --to completed --record，仅回写本卡 gate，Exit 0 后再同步状态，并以 --card T13 --receipt 复核、输出节点回执

checks.true_if: quota-policy-parity 18 例与新增回填 fixture 在共享 crate 与 Windows 上全部通过，Windows 全量测试全绿
checks.false_if: 任一用例失败或需改断言
checks.evidence: 2026-10-27: 先以迁移前实现跑新增 tests/fixtures/quota-carry-over-parity/cases.json (14 例): Windows (merge_snapshot + annotate_attempts + carry_over_skipped) 4 例不一致 —— skipped_fresh_provider_is_carried_in_previous_position / failure_without_qualified_history_is_unavailable (输出顺序)、legacy_empty_status_history_is_qualified (旧 empty 快照资格)、success_keeps_existing_freshness (改写已有 freshness) (local/logs/t13-win-before.log); mac QuotaCarryOverMerger 1 例 —— failed_query_borrows_previous_display_fields_including_balance (失败借用漏 balance / currency) (local/logs/t13-mac-before.log)。按 design/02 规则 12 定口径后 mac 补借两字段、Windows 改调共享 crate。迁移后: collector-policy 8 passed (quota-policy-parity 18 例与回填 14 例均逐字段相等); apps/win/src-tauri cargo test 224 passed / 0 failed (新增 merge_matches_shared_carry_over_fixture, 既有用例仅把 annotate_attempts / carry_over_skipped 调用换为 merge, 断言未改); RefreshSchedulerHarness 全部用例通过 (108 个用例函数, 含新增 quota carry-over shared parity fixture; 脚本末行打印的「106」是 main 上既有的硬编码旧值, T15 起改为实数)

checks.true_if: 共享 crate 不依赖 tauri、文件系统与网络，Windows 不再保留门禁 / 回填的第二份实现
checks.false_if: 出现 I/O 或 GUI 依赖，或两份实现并存
checks.evidence: 2026-10-27: collector-policy 的 Cargo.toml 只依赖 chrono / serde / serde_json (workspace 钉版), 源码无 std::fs / std::net / std::process / tauri 引用, #![deny(unsafe_code)]; Windows quota_policy.rs 只剩 pub use 与固定 suppress_external_quotas=false 的 plan 薄封装, runtime_core 的 provider_id / provider_of_id 改为 re-export、merge_snapshot 委托 merge_round、qualified 删除改用 is_qualified_previous, 带门禁的整轮应用改用共享 merge; grep 确认 apps/win 不再含 carry_over_skipped / annotate_attempts / fn qualified 定义; scheduler.rs 的 quota_policy::plan 调用点与 6 参签名不变
